options.text: About thirty ATP, and the cell is fine. One big fall, one big wheel.
options.feedback: Kabir's card: "Big fall, big wheel, lots of coins."

options.text: One ATP at most, and the rest of the fall becomes heat all at once. The cell cooks.
No ATP, because a single step cannot be coupled.

image.alt: A single glucose molecule releasing all its energy in one coupled step through one wheel, coins and heat both produced.
